title: update_pr.sh header names the script updatepr.sh
claim: Line 2 of tools/audit/seat/update_pr.sh introduces the script as 'updatepr.sh <branch> <code-sha|-> <body-file> [issues...]', but the script's $0 basename is update_pr.sh and no updatepr.sh is tracked anywhere at the ref.
mechanism: A rename (updatepr.sh -> update_pr.sh) left the header's self-name behind. Fails D5-criteria C2.

evidence.contention_note: shared box during fan-out; count is contention-immune

perturbation.change: --perturb update_pr: the script copied and run under the header's name in a temp dir, and that name added to the tracked set

metric_definition: 1 when the name the header gives differs from the basename bash reports for the script, or is not a tracked file name.
phenomenon_property: Every repository path, script name, usage-line option and stated item count a comment unit or docstring in the seat's cells names resolves at the ref and agrees with what the code it sits on delivers (D5-criteria C1, C2)
